en.quote: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
en.riddle: Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
en.speaker: King of Israel

he.quote: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֵר מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָֽא
he.speaker: מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל

en.8: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

he.8: וַיִּקְרָא מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־סָרִיס אֶחָד וַיֹּאמֶר מַהֵר מִיכָיְהוּ בֶן־יִמְלָֽא׃

en.quote: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
en.riddle: let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.
en.speaker: messenger

he.quote: וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ לִקְרֹא לְמִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִאִים פֶּֽה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וִֽיהִי־נָא דְבָרְךָ כְּאַחַד מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּֽוֹב
he.speaker: הַמַּלְאָךְ

en.12: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let thy word therefore, I pray thee, be like one of theirs, and speak thou good.

he.12: וְהַמַּלְאָךְ אֲשֶׁר־הָלַךְ ׀ לִקְרֹא לְמִיכָיְהוּ דִּבֶּר אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה דִּבְרֵי הַנְּבִאִים פֶּֽה־אֶחָד טוֹב אֶל־הַמֶּלֶךְ וִֽיהִי־נָא דְבָרְךָ כְּאַחַד מֵהֶם וְדִבַּרְתָּ טּֽוֹב׃

en.quote: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
en.riddle: thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
en.speaker: Micaiah

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר מִיכָיְהוּ הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבוֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵֽא
he.riddle: הִנְּךָ רֹאֶה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֲשֶׁר תָּבוֹא חֶדֶר בְּחֶדֶר לְהֵחָבֵֽא
he.speaker: מִיכָיְהוּ

en.24: And Micaiah said, Behold, thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
